## Description

A boat-shaped pennate diatom (~50 × 14 µm) in a silica frustule; it glides along its raphe at a few
µm/s with reversals. Golden chloroplasts (fucoxanthin). Each division makes one daughter smaller. It
needs dissolved silica for every new valve and vitamin B₁₂ from bacteria.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `moss` (weight 0.25), `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15), `sea_ice` (weight 4); 20 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A lanceolate outline with pointed ends (superellipse exponent < 2), [raphe gliding](../../mechanics/locomotion.md),
Si limitation and [B₁₂ auxotrophy](../../mechanics/metabolism-and-nutrients.md).

## Not implemented yet

- Size reduction at each division (MacDonald–Pfitzer) and auxospores are not modelled.
- Division constricts at the waist ([bug](../../bugs/diatom-division-geometry.md)).
- Genus-level being without a measured µmax.

## Unique and shared mechanics

The reference raphid diatom; shares gliding with *Pinnularia* and *Closterium*.
